critic.fix_suggestion: Relocate the four engine geometries from their current floating positions to the wing underside. Apply a translation transform to align each engine's center of mass with the corresponding pylon coordinates, ensuring they are nested within the wing structure rather than separated by a gap.

discrepancies.observed: Four engines are floating independently in space away from the wings.
discrepancies.reference: Engines are physically attached to pylons under the wing structure.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move and attach engine geometries to wing pylon positions.

discrepancies.observed: The landing gear struts are detached from the fuselage and wing roots, floating below.
discrepancies.reference: Struts are structurally integrated into the main body and wing underside.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Attach landing gear geometry to fuselage/wing connection points.

discrepancies.observed: The wings appear to be separate objects with a visible gap at the root.
discrepancies.reference: Wings blend seamlessly into the lower fuselage structure.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move wing roots inward to overlap and merge with the fuselage geometry.

discrepancies.observed: The horizontal stabilizer is floating behind the vertical fin.
discrepancies.reference: Horizontal stabilizers are attached to the rear fuselage/tail cone.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Attach tailplane geometry to the rear fuselage structure.
